I am a PhD candidate in sociology at the [FSS/MUNI](https://soc.fss.muni.cz/en). My doctoral research is part of the [PRINS](https://www.prins-opjak.cz/en) project.

My research connects social stratification, the family, and state context. 

I hold a BA in Sociology with Economics and an MA in Sociology (Economics module). During my undergraduate studies, I spent exchange stays at the University of Derby, the University of Edinburgh, and the University of Zürich.
